risk_description: Simplification may remove information needed for informed action
Plain-language messaging may unintentionally overpromise eligibility
Reminder timing may expose sensitive service use on shared devices
Assisted support may create demand that exceeds staffing capacity
Commitment prompts may create guilt without reducing structural barriers
Status transparency may expose delays without enough recovery capacity
Pre-filled information may propagate inaccurate records if correction is difficult
Escalation may advantage assertive users if criteria are unclear
